Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: SecureTech Alarm Solutions specializes in the installation and maintenance of comprehensive alarm systems for residential and commercial properties. Our services include the design, installation, and monitoring of state-of-the-art security solutions compliant with NFPA regulations. We ensure that all installed systems are operational and maintained according to industry standards. Additionally, we provide consulting services for custom security solutions and transparently disclose any equipment rentals associated with our operations.

ational alarm system installed and maintained by the insured business or a qualified subcon-
tractor. Risks where the alarm system is non-functional or absent are disqualified.
